=You are a friendly WhatsApp assistant for YOUR INSTITUTE NAME.

Before you answer ANY question about the Medical, Engineering or Business programs (fees, admission, duration, anything program-related), ALWAYS call the "Look Up School Info" tool first to check the real information.

Only answer using what the tool gives you back — never invent facts or guess.

parameters.toolDescription: Use this to look up real information about our school programs (medical, engineering, business) — fees, admission requirements, duration, anything program-related. Always check this before answering a program-related question.

parameters.content:
# STAGE 1 — IS THIS A NEW PERSON?
Every message that comes in passes through here first.

**Node 2** filters out WhatsApp's "delivered"/"read" receipts — only real messages get through.

**Node 3** checks a Google Sheet tab called "Contacts" to see if this phone number has messaged before. **Node 4** reads that result and decides new-or-not. This is a REAL record in your Sheet — not memory — so it keeps working correctly even if you edit and reactivate this workflow later.

**Node 5** splits the path: brand-new → go up (say hello). Already talked before → go down.

## 6a. SAY HELLO  →  7a. REMEMBER THEM
Only fires for a brand-new number.

**6a** sends the welcome text plus 3 tappable buttons.
**7a** immediately writes their phone number + today's date into the "Contacts" tab — this is what makes node 3 recognize them next time.

✏️ **Edit before using:**
- Swap in your real Phone Number ID (in 6a's URL)
- Swap in your real institute name (in 6a's message text)
- Pick your Document + "Contacts" sheet in 7a

# STAGE 2 — THEY TAPPED A BUTTON
Runs when someone we've already greeted taps one of the 3 menu buttons.

**7b** figures out which button they tapped. **8b** looks that word up as a row in your "School Info" tab. **9b** sends whatever is in that row's "Info" column back as a normal text message.

Simple lookup — no AI involved here.

# STAGE 3 — THEY ASKED SOMETHING IN THEIR OWN WORDS
Runs when someone we've already greeted types anything other than tapping a button — e.g. "how much are the engineering fees?"

**7c** grabs their exact question.

**8c is an AI AGENT** — a smart assistant that can decide, by itself, whether it needs to check a fact before replying. It has two helpers plugged in underneath:
• **Groq Chat Model** — the "brain" that reads the question and writes the reply.
• **School Info Tool** — the SAME "School Info" sheet tab from Stage 2. The agent only answers using what this tool gives back — that's what "RAG" means.

**9c** pulls the plain-text reply out. **10c** sends it back on WhatsApp.

✏️ **Edit before using:** replace YOUR INSTITUTE NAME inside node 8c's system message box.

## 🧠 GROQ CHAT MODEL
The "brain" plugged into the AI Agent above. Groq is a free/very cheap AI provider.

Nothing to change here except the credential (see the credentials note below).

## 📖 SCHOOL INFO TOOL
The exact same "School Info" sheet tab as node 8b, wired in as a tool the AI can use.

Pick the same Document + Sheet here as in 8b. Nothing else to change — the description telling the AI when to use it is already written.

## GOOGLE SHEET SETUP — 2 TABS IN ONE FILE

**Tab 1: "School Info"** (used by nodes 8b + the School Info Tool)
Option | Info
medical | (info)
engineering | (info)
business | (info)
⚠️ Option values must exactly match: medical, engineering, business (lowercase).

**Tab 2: "Contacts"** (used by nodes 3 + 7a)
Phone | FirstContactAt
(starts empty — the workflow fills this in by itself as people message you)

Create both tabs before you start filling in nodes.

# 🛡️ WHY THIS VERSION IS SAFE TO LEAVE RUNNING

1. **Contacts are remembered in your real Google Sheet** (Tab 2), not in n8n's temporary memory. Editing or reactivating this workflow will NEVER cause everyone to be "re-welcomed."

2. **Every node that talks to an outside service** (WhatsApp, Google Sheets, the AI) is set to **automatically retry twice, 2 seconds apart**, before giving up. Most brief hiccups (a slow response, a momentary network blip) fix themselves without anyone noticing.

3. **If a node still fails after retrying**, this workflow stops that one run and hands off to a separate companion workflow — "WhatsApp Bot Error Notifier" — which emails the admin automatically. That's a SEPARATE file. See its own sticky notes for the one setup step needed to connect it (Settings → Error Workflow).

✅ This does NOT mean nothing can ever go wrong — if Meta, Groq, or Google itself has an outage, or your WhatsApp token expires, this workflow still can't send messages during that time. What it DOES mean: you'll find out immediately by email instead of only noticing when a student complains days later.

# 🔑 EVERY CREDENTIAL YOU NEED, IN ONE PLACE
This workflow needs 4 different credentials. Here's exactly what each one is, where to get it, and what to type into n8n.

────────────────────────────

### 1️⃣ WHATSAPP OAUTH API  →  Node 1 (the trigger)
Click the node → Credential → Create New:
- **Client ID** → your Meta App ID (developers.facebook.com → your app → App settings → Basic)
- **Client Secret** → your Meta App Secret (same page)

### 2️⃣ WHATSAPP API  →  Nodes 9b and 10c (reuse the SAME one on both)
- **Access Token** → your permanent WhatsApp access token
- **Business Account ID** → your WABA ID (Meta → your app → WhatsApp → API Setup)
After saving, pick your real number from the "Phone Number ID" dropdown that appears.

### 3️⃣ HEADER AUTH  →  Node 6a (the HTTP Request node)
- **Name** → Authorization
- **Value** → Bearer  followed by your access token (one space after "Bearer")

### 4️⃣ GOOGLE SHEETS ACCOUNT  →  Nodes 3, 7a, 8b, and the School Info Tool (all FOUR reuse the same sign-in)
Click any one → Credential → Sign in with Google → pick the account that owns your Sheet → allow access. Then just select that same credential on the other three.

### 5️⃣ GROQ API  →  the Groq Chat Model node
1. console.groq.com → sign up (free) → API Keys → Create API Key
2. Copy the key (shown only once)
3. Click the Groq Chat Model node → Credential → Create New → paste into **API Key** → Save

────────────────────────────
💡 Once you create a credential, n8n remembers it — next time just pick it from the dropdown instead of making a new one.
